create_function_query: create a function that sends a chat completion request to the Together AI API
build_chat_completion: build a request to query the Together AI chat completions endpoint with a model and messages
run_query_model: run the query function with a user message and a Together AI model alias
test_query_response: test the query function returns a JSON response with choices and message fields
summarize_query_headers: summarize how the query function uses Bearer token authorization headers
